alt: An elaborate dessert display features a koi pond made of blue and white candy balls with an orange and white koi fish, situated at the base of a chocolate waterfall cascading down tiered rocks.
A low-angle shot captures a dark, sculpted tree branch adorned with cascading clusters of pink artificial flowers, set against a backdrop of a geometric-patterned screen and an overcast sky.

An elaborate cake display features a figurine of a woman in a colorful kimono sitting beside a black cherry blossom tree and a cascading waterfall with koi fish, all set against a traditional folding screen.

A colorful statue of a woman in traditional Asian attire, featuring a vibrant yellow robe with red floral patterns, a green and blue striped sash, and an elaborate black headdress adorned with red flowers.
